verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੪ : ਬੰਦੇ ਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੀ ਦਸ਼ਾ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 4 : ba(n)dhe dhaa ba(n)dhaa manmukh dhee dhashaa

en.bdb: Slave of the man; the position of the manmukh  ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਬੰਦੇ ਦਾ ਬੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur saahib chhadd kai manmukh hoi ba(n)dhe dhaa ba(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Manmukh, the mind-orientated, leaving away the true Guru Lord becomes slave of man.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਲਾਮ ਕਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: hukamee ba(n)dhaa hoi kai nit uTh jai salaam kara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Becoming errand boy of man he goes daily to salute him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਥ ਜੋੜਿ ਕੈ ਹੋਇ ਹਜ਼ੂਰੀ ਖੜਾ ਰਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: aaTh pahar hath joR kai hoi hazooree khaRaa raha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: All the twenty four hours (eight pahars) with folded hands he stands before his master.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੀਦ ਨ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਸੁਖ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੂਲੀ ਚੜੑਹਿਆ ਰਹੈ ਡਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: needh na bhukh na sukh tis soolee chaR(h)hiaa rahai ddara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Sleep, hunger and pleasure he does not have and remains so scared as if he has been sacrificed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਲਾ ਧੁਪ ਛਾਉ ਸਿਰ ਉਤੈ ਝਲਿ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: paanee paalaa dhup chhaau sir utai jhal dhukh saha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Throughout rains, cold, sunlight, shade, he undergoes myriad sufferings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਤਸਬਾਜੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਰਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਘਾਇਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਰੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: aatasabaajee saar vekh ran vich ghail hoi mara(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: In the battlefield (of life) this same person, considering sparks of iron as fireworks gets mortally wounded.
Without the (shelter of) perfect Guru, he wanders through the species.
